specsRaw.Rock Star: The dial of the Stratton is made from a piece of eisenkiesel, a semi-precious gemstone that is mined, cut and polished into a unique dial that is just one millimetre thick.

specsRaw.Moon Light: The watch features hour markers made from Lumicast, a blend of ceramic and Super-LumiNova that offers unbeatable legibility at night. Naturally, the hands are also filled with Super-LumiNova.

specsRaw.Night Light: Not only are the hands filled with luminous Grade X2 Super-LumiNova, but the applied batons are moulded from solid blocks of X2 Super-LumiNova. Together, these provide unparalleled legibility in the dark.

specsRaw.Movement: Swiss Made Sellita SW330-2 'Top Grade' movement
specsRaw.Sublime Slopes -: The lugs are the defining feature of the GMT Bezel case. In addition to a large polished chamfer that cuts into the brushed finish, the lugs themselves have a “ski slope” shape where the tips curve slightly upwards. It’s a subtle touch that has a big impact on how the watch feels on the wrist.
specsRaw.Reliable Mechanics -: Powering this GMT is the Sellita SW330-2 automatic movement. This dependable calibre beats at a smooth rate of 28,800 bph (4Hz), contains 25 jewels and has a 56-hour power reserve. What’s more, this is the 'Top Grade' version of the SW330, so it’s been adjusted for accuracy in 5 positions.
specsRaw.Afterglow -: To guarantee legibility under all conditions, the watch’s hands and markers have heavy applications of X1 Super-LumiNova.
specsRaw.Turnaround -: To track a second time zone the bezel is bidirectional and has a 24-hour scale protected by a scratch-resistant sapphire crystal insert. When used with the coloured GMT hand, the wearer can read the time in another part of the globe.

specsRaw.Compression Innovation: Just like vintage EPSA super compressors, the Aqua Compressor case uses the pressure of the water to compress the gaskets sealing the watch, thus increasing the watch's water resistance the deeper it goes.
specsRaw.Light & Strong: The case of the Aqua Compressor is crafted from grade 2 titanium and is remarkably light, weighing just 62g. It measures 41mm in diameter, with a 45mm lug-to-lug, and is just 12.5mm thick.
specsRaw.Twin Crowns: The Aqua Compressors feature the twin crowns that are a signature of compressor dive watches. Both crowns screw down and are titanium inset with bronze caps that feature a crosshatch pattern and the Farer logo. The bottom crown operates the bezel and the top sets the time.
specsRaw.Luminous Quality: The Aqua Compressor features a generous application of Grade X1 Super-LumiNova across the hands, hour markers, and bezel, ensuring it's readable in any light.

specsRaw.Movement: Swiss Made Sellita SW330-2 'Top Grade' movement
specsRaw.Sublime Slopes -: The lugs are the defining feature of the GMT Bezel case. In addition to a large polished chamfer that cuts into the brushed finish, the lugs themselves have a “ski slope” shape where the tips curve slightly upwards. It’s a subtle touch that has a big impact on how the watch feels on the wrist.
specsRaw.Reliable Mechanics -: Powering this GMT is the Sellita SW330-2 automatic movement. This dependable calibre beats at a smooth rate of 28,800 bph (4Hz), contains 25 jewels and has a 56-hour power reserve. What’s more, this is the 'Top Grade' version of the SW330, so it’s been adjusted for accuracy in 5 positions.
specsRaw.Afterglow -: To guarantee legibility under all conditions, the watch’s hands and markers have heavy applications of X1 Super-LumiNova.
specsRaw.Turnaround -: To track a second time zone the bezel is bidirectional and has a 24-hour scale protected by a scratch-resistant sapphire crystal insert. When used with the coloured GMT hand, the wearer can read the time in another part of the globe.
